recommendations.title: Add contigs parsing error diagnostics
recommendations.problem: 422 errors mention malformed contigs but no guidance on debugging contig syntax errors (missing chain, wrong range format, chain breaks)
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes users will consult references for full syntax; inline diagnostics missing
recommendations.fix: Add to Troubleshooting: '422 with contig errors → common mistakes: (1) chain ID mismatch (contig 'B1-50' but PDB only has chain A), (2) wrong range format (use '50-80' not '50:80'), (3) missing /0 chain break separator. See references/api.md Contigs Language Reference for full syntax.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for diffusion
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running RFDiffusion with same inputs produces identical backbones
recommendations.fix: Add to Request Pattern: 'Determinism: RFDiffusion is stochastic — same contigs and hotspots will produce different backbones each run (diffusion sampling is non-deterministic). For reproducible campaigns, save generated PDB artifacts rather than regenerating. Use diffusion_steps=50 for consistent quality across runs.'

recommendations.title: Clarify dummy PDB applicability
recommendations.problem: Dummy PDB documented for de novo but not explicitly stated whether needed for motif/binder modes on hosted
recommendations.root_cause: Workaround specific to de novo but scope not fully bounded
recommendations.fix: Expand dummy PDB note in Contigs DSL: 'Dummy PDB only needed for hosted de novo (input_pdb validation). Motif scaffolding and binder design use real target PDB as input_pdb; no dummy needed for those modes on hosted or any mode on local.'
